validity_findings: All twelve validity gates V1-V8 pass on the scored schedule (V1_code_fidelity_manifest, V2_transport_conformance, V3_no_leak, V4_determinism, V5_arm_liveness, V6_counter_instrumentation, V7_matched_correctness, V8_ceiling_band, V8_m0_counter_distinctness, V8_mechanism_off, V8_memory_off_attribution, V8_reveal_order_attribution). No gate failure exists; MEASUREMENT_INVALID branch is correctly not triggered.

Determinism verified: the 80-cell × 20-session scored matrix was executed twice with byte-identical per-cell outcomes (determinism_ok=true in run_scored.json). The server_secret derivation is fully deterministic (no secrets, clock, or os.urandom).
No-leak protocol invariants (NC-NO-LEAK, F-LEAK gate) are clean on all 10 checked invariants in both probe and scored runs. The binding appears only in its own precursor receipt.

Code fidelity manifest (V1) records the EXECUTE harness sha256 (8ee0de445efc5c4c3c32e090a9799b24c092785d6d2bf31321aea3255334f987) matching spec.design_satisfiability_probe.source_sha256 and the prereg.md BEGIN/END SBA-MEM-HARNESS block. Python version 3.12.15 recorded.
Transport conformance (V2) passes: all HTTP endpoints (healthz, session, task, commit) respond with correct status codes and JSON schemas on stdlib loopback HTTP.
Arm liveness (V5) holds: T-AMORTIZED-DISCOVERY and PC-EXACT-REPLAY achieve 1.0 at every family/novelty band; all ten arms execute end-to-end without exceptions.
Counter instrumentation (V6) is complete: all four dimensions (http_calls, retrieval_calls, verification_calls, repair_calls) recorded per cell with matched accounting across all arms.

Matched correctness (V7) holds exactly: matched_correctness == success_rate in all 80 scored cells (exact-match scoring). Minimum arm success_rate across all cells is 0.875 (B-COLD-RE-DERIVE etc. at F1|0.5), at the CORRECTNESS_FLOOR.

Sensitivity sub-gates (V8) all pass: ceiling band (novelty 0.0 all arms 1.0), mechanism-off (cold reaches 1.0), memory-off attribution (B-MEMORY-RECEIPT with per-task log reset degrades to (K-1)/K), reveal-order attribution (chain-before-precursor fails), M0 counter distinctness (T vs B-COLD-RE-DERIVE = 2/4 dimensions distinct at scored bands).
baseline_findings: The memoryless M0 baselines (B-COLD-RE-DERIVE, B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED, B-KNOWLEDGE-NO-MEMORY) all achieve exactly (K-1)/K = 0.875 (F1) / 0.900 (F2) at novelty >= 0.50, matching the frozen arithmetic and the predecessor's certificate. Counter distinctness vs T is 2/4 dimensions (http_calls and repair_calls) on both families, satisfying V8_m0_counter_distinctness.

The state-only memory comparator B-MEMORY-STATE (M1) also achieves (K-1)/K, confirming that GET-observation state alone does not recover the binding (the binding lives only in a precursor receipt). This is the expected and observed isolation of 'state memory without receipt memory'.

The M2a comparator B-MEMORY-WINDOW-1 (retains 1 receipt) certifies at novelty 0.50 (capacity 1 >= distance 1) but not at 0.75 (capacity 1 < distance 2), exactly as predicted by the closed-form capacity threshold.

The M2b comparator B-MEMORY-WINDOW-2 (retains 2 receipts) and the M3 primary comparator B-MEMORY-RECEIPT (full log) both reach 1.0 at both scored bands, collapsing the treatment margin to 0. They are success- and counter-identical to T (0/4 counter dimensions distinct). This is the disclosed collapse mechanism on a single-success-path substrate, not a comparator bug.

The retrieval variant B-RETRIEVAL-MEMORYFUL (M3 + stale retrieval) equals B-MEMORY-RECEIPT in rate (1.0) while increasing retrieval_calls, confirming memory is the cause and retrieval is inert (NC-RETRIEVAL-REDUNDANT).

All control nulls behave as pre-declared: NC-MECHANISM-OFF raises cold to 1.0 (certificate FALSE), NC-MEMORY-OFF and NC-REVEAL-ORDER-FLIPPED both return (K-1)/K, NC-CEILING-BAND holds, NC-WINDOW-MONOTONIC holds (window-1 <= window-2 <= full), NC-NO-DISCOVERY-DIRECT and NC-BINDING-UNIQUENESS are probe-verified clean.
claim_ceiling: The certified SBA-CREDENTIAL-FREE-V2 bank's (K-1)/K dynamic range does NOT survive a within-session full-receipt-memory comparator (B-MEMORY-RECEIPT). The range is a function of comparator within-session receipt-retention capacity, collapsing at capacity >= chain-to-precursor distance (1 at novelty 0.50, 2 at novelty 0.75). Weaker memoryful comparators (B-MEMORY-STATE, B-MEMORY-WINDOW-1 at novelty 0.75) do certify, yielding decision PARTIAL. The bank cannot supply discriminative dynamic range for a benchmark whose comparator arms carry within-session receipt memory (such as the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT). This is a bounded substrate-validity result for SBA-CREDENTIAL-FREE-V2 with K∈{8,10} only; no mechanism promotion, no claim-status change, no generalization to external agents or natural Web tasks.
unresolved: Whether a hardened V3 bank whose success requires mechanism- or composition-dependent behaviour (rather than mere receipt retention) can supply memory-robust dynamic range for a four-arm benchmark; this bank-design question is correctly handed to Product per the mandate stop trigger.
Whether real external comparator arms (COLD/INSTRUCTIONS/RETRIEVAL in C-LLM-INHERIT) behave like within-session full-receipt memory; only synthetic comparator policies were measured here.
Whether the flagship four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark can be run at all: B1 (audited parameterized carrier) and B3 (capable same-protocol endpoint) remain unresolved and gate it independently.
Whether the same capacity-threshold result holds for K outside {8,10} or for other credential-free constructions; only K=8 and K=10 were measured.
Whether the primary comparator's success/counter identity with T can be broken by a substrate change while preserving a credential-free discovery path; untested here.
